t: This is Stanhope House, at numbers 46 and 47 Park Lane in Mayfair. It is a Grade II listed building. It was designed by the architect and interior decorator William Henry Romaine-Walker, and commissioned by Robert William Hudson. Hudson was born in West Bromwich, the eldest son of a soap-flake manufacturer, and he ran his father's company until it was taken over by Lever Brothers in 1908. So this is a house on Park Lane built on the proceeds of soap.
